title: Royal Bk Cda Montreal Que (RY) Shareholder Montrusco Bolton Investments INC Cut Its Position
text:
Royal Bk Cda Montreal Que (RY) Shareholder Montrusco Bolton Investments INC Cut Its Position Posted by Hazel Jackson 15 pm
Montrusco Bolton Investments Inc decreased its stake in Royal Bk Cda Montreal Que (RY) by 5.77% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Montrusco Bolton Investments Inc sold 110,552 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.88% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.81M shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $144.69M, down from 1.92M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Montrusco Bolton Investments Inc who had been investing in Royal Bk Cda Montreal Que for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $101.71B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.14% or $1.07 during the last trading session, reaching $70.56. About 612,662 shares traded. Royal Bank of Canada (NYSE:RY) has declined 11.53% since December 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 11.53% the S&P500.
Montrusco Bolton Investments Inc, which manages about $6.00B and $1.63B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Microsoft Corp (NASDAQ:MSFT) by 74,992 shares to 227,347 shares, valued at $26.00M in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 53,092 shares in the quarter, for a total of 100,637 shares, and has risen its stake in Biogen Inc (NASDAQ:BIIB).
Analysts await Royal Bank of Canada (NYSE:RY) to report earnings on February, 22. They expect $1.64 earnings per share, down 4.65 % or $0.08 from last year’s $1.72 per share. RY’s profit will be $2.36 billion for 10.76 P/E if the $1.64 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.71 actual earnings per share reported by Royal Bank of Canada for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -4.09 % negative EPS growth.
